Loading searchable index...

Challenge

Help users find relevant talks from a free-text query, then discover similar talks once they find one they like.

What I did

Cleaned and combined titles, descriptions and tags, built a 5,000-feature unigram/bigram TF-IDF index, and ranked results by cosine similarity in a Tkinter desktop app.

Outcome

On the evaluated “education creativity” query: Precision@5 = 0.80, Precision@10 = 0.60, Recall@10 = 0.75. Main limitation: synonyms are not matched.

How a query is ranked

  1. Title + description + tags
  2. Normalise text
  3. TF-IDF vectors
  4. Cosine similarity
  5. Top-k results
